title: SEO Metadata
description: Publisher-ready metadata produced by SEO Analyst. Used at publish time to set title, meta description, slug, and social metadata. Does not include full article content — that is in content-handoff.json. Validates against seo-analyst.md Outputs Produced section and overlay slug/frontmatter rules.

url_or_path.description: Live URL or repo-relative content path this metadata applies to.

brief_ref.description: Reference to the seo-content-brief.json brief_id this metadata was produced from.

audit_ref.description: Reference to the seo-audit-report.json audit_id that approved this metadata.

title.description: Final title tag. ≤60 chars. Must contain primary keyword. Respects overlay rules.

title_char_count.description: Character count of the title field for quick validation.

meta_description.description: Final meta description. ≤160 chars. Must contain primary keyword. Compelling for click-through.

meta_char_count.description: Character count of the meta_description field.

slug.description: Final URL slug (repo-relative or absolute path). Follows site overlay slug conventions. Lowercase, hyphen-separated, no trailing slash.

primary_keyword.description: The single primary keyword this page targets. Used for cannibalization tracking.

secondary_keywords.description: 2–4 secondary keywords targeted in the article body.

schema_types.description: Schema types recommended for this page. Frontend implements JSON-LD per these types. Article is always included.

canonical_url.description: Canonical URL if different from the published URL. Leave null if self-canonical.

social.description: Open Graph / Twitter Card metadata for social sharing. Optional but recommended.

og_title.description: Open Graph title. Can differ slightly from title tag (≤70 chars).

og_image.description: Absolute URL or repo-relative path to the featured image for OG.

frontmatter_fields.description: Additional overlay-specific fields can be added here without breaking validation.

updateDate.description: Last updated date for evergreen_refresh content.

category.description: Post category as defined by the site's content collection config.

draft.description: Draft status. Set to false only when publisher confirms ready to go live — SEO Analyst does NOT change this without explicit user instruction.

image.description: Featured image path or URL for the post.

author.description: Author name as it appears in frontmatter.

seo_publishing_overlay.description: Fields for seo-publishing dual-site sprint tracking.

geo_ready.description: True when answer-first + query fan-out + schema types are all specified.

status.description: Metadata lifecycle status. under_review = produced and awaiting Content Writer or publisher confirmation. ready_to_publish = approved by audit and safe to apply to CMS/frontmatter.

notes.description: Any remaining notes for publisher or Content Writer.

hreflang.description: hreflang attribute for multi-locale content (e.g. 'vi', 'en', 'en-US'). Null for single-locale sites. Consumed by Frontend when implementing <link rel="alternate" hreflang="..."> tags.

ai_bots_allowed.description: Whether AI crawlers (OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot) are allowed by robots.txt for this URL. True = allowed (GEO/AEO optimization is meaningful). False = AI citation not achievable without robots.txt change (escalate to Frontend/DevOps).

examples.title: Thu Thiem Neighborhood Guide 2026 | Expat Renting Tips
examples.meta_description: Complete guide to renting in Thu Thiem in 2026. Rental prices, best streets, transport links, and expat tips for District 2's newest neighborhood.

social.og_title: Thu Thiem Neighborhood Guide 2026 — Expat Rental Tips
social.og_description: Everything expats need to know about living in Thu Thiem: rental prices, transport, best streets, and a 2026 market update.

examples.notes: Apply frontmatter_fields to the MDX file before publish. Schema implementation (Article + FAQPage + BreadcrumbList) is a post-publish Frontend task per audit technical escalation.
